name: Gridfinity Boxes (bins)
frame: Box centred in X/Y; z = 0 is the underside of the feet; the label (if any) sits on the +Y wall and runs along X.

source.standard: Onshape 'TemplateBox_HeightAdjust' (aee95cbe04963c37301ca12a, version 1709bdbec751f2c8b82e4d11, Part Studio 'Template'); same tree as 'TemplateBox' 009f11a5d6c90faddac6565f but with height in 7 mm units
source.label: Onshape 'Gridfinity_box_Beschriftung' (23ef78d9a8fac409ffab3feb, Part Studio 'GridFinityStorageWithLabel'): derives the template and adds label ledge, label plate and scoop

official._source: gridfinity.xyz/specification, as encoded in gridfinity-rebuilt-openscad src/core/standard.scad

foot._note: [z, offset from the 42 mm cell outline]: 0.8 @ 45 deg, 1.8 vertical, 2.15 @ 45 deg = 4.75; corner radius = 4 - offset

lip._note: inward from the box outline, above the wall top T: 0.7 @ 45 deg, 1.8 vertical, 1.9 @ 45 deg to the outer edge (4.4 high, 2.6 deep), top edge rounded r 0.6

magnet._note: 4 per cell at (+-13, +-13) from the cell centre, for 6 x 2 mm magnets

design._note: Not defined by the standard; taken from the Onshape designs.

label._note: Ledge along X on the +Y inner wall: top at T - plate_t, 13 deep from the inner wall, 0.95 front edge, supported at 60 deg from the wall. The plate fills the pocket between ledge front and lip, flush with the wall top.

scoop._note: Concave fill between floor and the -Y inner wall (label box only). Onshape uses r 25 at every height, which pokes above the lip of boxes lower than 5 units; here r = min(25, T - floor_top - lip_support - 0.5).

x_count.label: Width
x_count.help: X, 42 mm per unit; the label runs along it

plate_gap.label: Plate clearance
plate_gap.help: per side, mm; makes the label plate smaller

rugged_case._note: Informational fit check against Gridfinity/spec/case_params.json (z_count 5..25, x/y 3..8). A box of h units fits a case of z_count >= h: the lip clears the closed lid by 1.0-1.25 mm (Gridfinity/web/node/bin_case_fit.mjs, checked for n = 5, 12, 25).
